text:
Samir Rao: Quick question: how should Console show automatic fallback activations during rollouts? thinking a "ribbon" on the rollout with an evidence drawer.

Lina Zhou: Ribbon + compact reason makes sense. Keep default view terse: mode + human reason + sampled fraction. Expand for evidence.

DevOps Bot: rollout r-20260410-02 auto-fallback -> mode: graceful_degrade, reason: high_latency_spike, sampled: 5/500

Evan Lee: We should show both computed_reason and buckets of raw causes (e.g., latency>500ms: 420, 504:80). Operators need to validate the mapped reason.

Samir Rao: Privacy: redact bodies. Display path, status, stable event hash. "View raw" only for IAM-role="audit".

Lina Zhou: UI: a small "why" pill that shows a tooltip breakdown and a link to open the drawer with sampled events and sampling policy. Include retention notice (30d).

Evan Lee: API proposal: /rollouts/:id/events returns summary object with computed_reason, raw_reasons array, sampled_fraction, sampling_meta (policy_id, seed), sampled_event_ids. Keep pointers not full payloads.

Samir Rao: Storage decision: compute-on-write summaries and keep sampled pointers 30d. Less load on reads.

Lina Zhou: Microcopy: "Automatically switched to fallback due to elevated latency — 1% of requests sampled." short and clear.

Evan Lee: I'll open a tiny RFC + PR with schema and tests for redaction and deterministic sample ids.

Samir Rao: Thanks everyone. @Evan please add mock screenshots to RFC and note IAM gating.

DevOps Bot: acknowledged: task create -> RFC-2026-04-10
